items.criterion: A scheduled chapter's manifest answers not found to a visitor and an untipped reader.
items.judgment: Request chapter 4's manifest signed out and as a fresh reader.

items.criterion: A verified tip of 500 or more opens chapter 4 to its tipper within 30 seconds.
items.judgment: Claim a return token, deliver a signed tip and poll the manifest.

items.criterion: A notification whose bytes changed after signing is refused with 401.
items.judgment: Sign a body, alter one space and deliver it.

items.criterion: Concurrent deliveries of one tip store one tip row.
items.judgment: Deliver one tip six times at a barrier and count the stored rows.

items.criterion: An imported layer image is stored re-encoded in the bucket at its content-hash key.
items.judgment: Import a PNG with a metadata chunk and compare the stored key with the served bytes.

items.criterion: Unsigned, altered or borrowed image signatures answer 404.
items.judgment: Fetch early-access image addresses with their signature removed, changed or swapped.

items.criterion: A refund revokes early access on the next request.
items.judgment: Deliver tip.refunded and read chapter 4 again.

items.criterion: A scheduled chapter is published within 60 seconds of its moment.
items.judgment: Schedule a chapter 15 seconds ahead and poll its state.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous progress writes leave one merged row.
items.judgment: Write two documents at a barrier and read the stored row.

items.criterion: A reader session calling an author-only endpoint is denied.
items.judgment: Call studio mutations with a reader token and read the chapter back.

items.criterion: A stale layer edit answers 409 version_conflict.
items.judgment: Edit a layer twice with one version.

items.criterion: Each route's first HTML response carries its pinned title, description and lang.
items.judgment: Fetch every public route in both locales and read the document head.

items.criterion: Both catalogues serve every pinned key and value.
items.judgment: Read both catalogues and compare them with the pinned table.

items.criterion: Unknown paths render the not-found page with 404.
